title: This 47-Million-Year-Old Owl Probably Hunted by Day
description:
A 47-million-year-old owl fossil from Germany's Messel Pit still has its last meal inside: a cockroach with iridescent wings, a trait linked to daytime insects.
Together with its short, stocky wing bones, it suggests early owls hunted by day, and that night hunting evolved later, roughly 47 to 34 million years ago.
